newsitem.title: NORWAY: DnB decision on BNbank likely after Easter.
newsitem.headline: DnB decision on BNbank likely after Easter.

text.p: Norway's top commercial bank Den norske Bank ASA (DnB) said on Monday it was unlikely to make any fresh announcement on whether it will increase its offer for Bolig og Naeringsbanken (BNbank) until after the Easter holidays.
DnB is currently in a bidding war with the country's fourth largest bank Fokus Bank ASA for the niche mortgage lender.
Fokus made a share exchange bid for BNbank last Tuesday and DnB stepped into the ring on Friday by announcing a cash offer, which valued BNbank at around 1.90 billion crowns.
Fokus later on Friday raised its share exchange ratio to value BNbank at 2.06 billion crowns.
"It will take a lot if we are to announce anything this side of Easter," said Jarl Veggan, head of information at DnB.
